what: Forest road at G1 (ADR 0086, issue #284): every PixelLab job, in order of the files they were first written to. gens is the job usage reported by the API; balance_before/after are account-wide (other sessions spend concurrently), so their difference is not the job cost.

request.description: Keep every shape, size, position and the camera angle exactly as drawn; only redraw the surfaces, wood grain, bark, needles, leaves, stone, straw and metal in a careful hand-drawn pixel style. Do not add any object, cloth, sign, lettering or decoration that is not in the drawing. A round terracotta clay oil jar with a cork stopper and a dark oil stain at the lip. High top-down view on a 2:1 isometric axis. Dark brown 1 pixel outline (#1b1410) on the silhouette, muted warm earth colours, 3 to 4 flat tone steps per material, warm light from the upper left, cool brown shade on the lower right, solid and heavy, matte, no white or near-white pixels, no gloss, no bevelled plank edges, no text.
